morphology_candidate.look_here_first: Start at the leaf base, not the flower: look for the small spinelike tubercle on the stem immediately below a short petiole, then confirm an erect plant with narrow toothed leaves and small yellow flowers.
diagnostic_traits: ovate to lanceolate leaves, serrate to base
small spinelike tubercle often present below petiole
yellow flowers solitary or clustered in axils

confusers.separator: S. spinosa is erect and often shows a petiole-base tubercle; S. abutilifolia is procumbent and mat-forming.
